PairingMethod.description: Which representation of a pairing challenge the device presents.

oneOf.description: The high-entropy credential carried by the QR payload.
The short code typed by hand next to the address.

Secret.description:
A pairing credential, manual code or device token. Serializes as a plain
string; `Debug` never prints the value, so it cannot reach logs or error
strings through a derived impl.

description: First frame from a device. Anything else closes the connection.

oneOf.description: Exchange a pairing challenge for a device token.

device_name.description: A label chosen by the device. Never an identity.

install_id.description:
A random identifier the app generates once per install and keeps.
Pairing again with the same one replaces that install's earlier
device record and revokes its token, instead of adding a record.
Not tied to the user; ignored unless it is 16 to 128 printable
ASCII characters. Older apps leave it out.

wire_names.description: `"thread"` asks for the thread names on the wire; see [`WIRE_NAMES_THREAD`].

oneOf.description: Present a device token obtained from an earlier `paired` frame.
